book.name: Mark
book.title: Yesu Keriso Tuyeghana Ahiꞌahina Mark Vivireina i Girugirumiya

content: Yesu, Rava Nimana Wanawana Ruꞌumana i Viyawahani
Mara emosi Yesu i wanavirameei po i rui aniviꞌemosi numana* auhinenina, ma nahidana rava nimana wanawana ruꞌumana i inanai i tughutughura.
Ma rava ghehauhi hi ghohei da Yesu hina viwavui, yamna aubaina hi inaꞌinana vaimaiha, mepa da viyagohina au maratomna we ravana ina viyawahani.
Ma ravana nimana wanawana ruꞌumana i riwei ipa, “Ma neꞌi po rava aunaohi ma mahiri.”
Anima rava i raubayadehi ipa, “Metauna raugagayona* i ahi, viyagohina au maratomna: ahi ta dewai bo apoꞌapoe ta dewai, ta viyawahana bo ta vihiraghena?” Egha hita paribeei ma atapuhi hi genuwana.

Anima amona i ghaighai ma i inana viravira babana nuwanuwahi i toghara, ma i vinuwaboya ma i riwa nae ravana nimana wanawana ruꞌumana auwarina ipa, “Nimam ma rodomi.” Ma nimana i rodomi yana i yawahana.
Anima Pharisees* yaghiyaghinaꞌava hi nae, po guyau Herod ana boru
marina maitehi hi viꞌemosi po Yesu vihiraghenana hi viꞌogatarei.

Yesu ma a tauvotagho maitehi hi nae hagahaga au gerahana, ma rava maghamaghauhi Yesu aiwa i dewadewaiya tuyeghana hi nonori po hi neꞌi auwarina. Ahi anineꞌi yana Galilee, Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea ma Jordan tupohi, anima Tyre ma Sidon meyagaihi auririvahi.

Rava maghamaghauhi i viyawahanihi ma ghehauhi doridoriꞌahi yana yohora hi amdudugheꞌi hipa hita vodadani. Aubaina po a tauvotagho i riwehi po aubaina wam hi nonoghei, babana rava hi magha duma hi garigaribewani.
Mepa nanaꞌarena rava aruwa apoꞌapoehi hi tanitaniwagehi Yesu hi inanai, yana aunaona hi peꞌu ma hi ghoreghore hipa, “Tam yana Maimaituwa Natuna!”
Ma aruwahi i vighaꞌehi da havena rava hita riwehi da tauna aiyaꞌi.
Yesu, Tauvotagho Vinevinehi* 12 i Vinehi
Yesu i ghae oya autepana ma rava i rauhogharehi, i ghorehi po hi neꞌi auwarina.
Ma maghauhi 12 i vinehi ma wava i verehi, tauvotagho vinevinehi.* Ma weꞌi aubaina i vinehi da tauna maitehi ma muriyai ita himira hopunehi rauguguya aubaina,
ma vitaniwaga i verehi po aruwa apoꞌapoehi hina raukaiwenihi.
Tauhi 12 ahi wava yana we nanaꞌarena: Simon (yana Yesu i viwavai po Peter
Zebedee natunatuna James ma a tevera John i ghorehi po Boanerges (Boanerges anona yana ‘waiparara natunatuna’),
Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew,
ma Thomas, James yana Alphaeus natuna, ma Thaddaeus, ma Simon yana Zealot
ma Judas Iscariot yana Yesu tauvibenabenameina.
Rava Hipa Aruwa Apoꞌapoena* Yesu ei Taniwagei
Yesu, a tauvotagho maitehi hi naeme au numa, ma wate rava hi riyaneꞌi yana numa hi vihowai po egha emoꞌemosina hita am.
A ghughuni hi nonori aiwa i tuputupuwa ma hipa, “Unuꞌununa i neyabayababa!” Aubaina hi neꞌi po hita taravaini po hita paꞌini.

Mai Judea* ahi raugagayo tauvihanahanapuweina Jerusalemei hi ghaꞌiraꞌi po Yesu hi deedei hipa, “Beelzebub yana aruwa apoꞌapoehi ahi bada, Yesu ei taniwagei! Aruwa apoꞌapoehi ahi bada a kajijirei we aruwahi e raukaiwenihi.”
Aubaina Yesu i ghorehi po hi neꞌi ma ampariruveruvei i vibabani auwarihi ipa, “Apo menanaꞌarena ma Taumodurere* ina vireta hopunenameei?
Inapa dobu ina viꞌam kahakaha ma hinai tona vivira, yana na dobuna apo egha ina mahiri.
Ma dam ina viꞌamkahakaha ma hinai tona vivira, yana apo na damna egha ina maꞌae.
Yamna aubaina inapa Taumodurere ana dobu hinai amkahakaha ma hinai tona vivira, yana apegha hina mahiri apo hina peꞌu babana ahi mara i kwaha.
Apegha meyanai rava kajikajijirana ana numa hina ruini po a purapura hina danenenei. Da aunaona hina raghiraghihi ma muriyai a purapura hina danenenei.
Taꞌu riwa moinana a ririwemi, rava ahi dewa ma ahi babani, apoꞌapoehi atapuna apo Maimaituwa ina nuwaꞌaharei.*
Ma aiya ravana Aruwa Vivireina ei jiboghi yana Maimaituwa apegha ina nuwaꞌaharei, babana naꞌi yana dewaboꞌa maꞌemaꞌe vavahaghana i dewai.”
Yesu i riwehi babana tauna Aruwa Vivireinei aruwa apoꞌapoehi i raukaiwenihi ma hi riwei hipa, “Aruwa apoꞌapoena* tauna ita ruini.”
Yesu a Ghughuni Moinana
Anima Yesu ayona ma varevarehina hi gheꞌeta po numa au mataꞌetana, hi mahimahiri ma ana riwa hi himiri.
Rava maghamaghauhi hi tughura kwaviviroi ma hi maꞌamaꞌae ma hi riwei hipa, “Ayom, varevarehim ma novunovum yana au dowa hi ghoheghohei po hina inanam.”
Yesu i paribeehi ipa, “Aiya ayoꞌuna ma varehiꞌuna?”
Anima i inana viravira po rava auririvana hi tughutughura i inanahi ma ipa, “Ona inanai! We ravahi yana ayoꞌu ma varevarehiꞌu!
Aiya ravana Maimaituwa a rauhoghara e dewadewai yana tauna varehiꞌu, novuꞌu ma ayoꞌu.”

footnotes.text: Guyau Herod ana boru yana (Herodians) Rome* a gabemani i vohagui ma ahi dobu ravahi hi benabenamei ma marina Pharisees* maitehi hi viꞌemosi ma ipa Yesu hina vihiragheni. We ravahi yana egha meyanai hitai turana.
Matthew ana wava ghehauna yana Levi.
Zealot anona yana ‘rava boruhi Rome* babadahi tauvighaviyehi’.

3:28-30 Yesu wehidana aiwa e ririweiya yana we ravahi nuwanuwahi i toghara po egha hitai nuwanuwatuhu da hina wanatavirahi. Rava Aruwa Vivireina hei jiboghiya anona yana hipa Yesu tauna egha Maimaituwa a Vinevine,* ma aruwa apoꞌapoena* itai bagibagi. Ma Aruwa Vivireina ei hegheta da tauna yana Maimaituwa a Vinevine.
